video_title: Bigger deal for Knicks: Mitchell Robinson’s injury or OKC-Spurs going to Game 7? | First Take

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's injury is the bigger concern for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: You need that big body. He's needed.
quotes.quote: To me, it's Mitchell Robinson's injury. You need that big body. Diakite is a guy that I think has some skill and can do some things for the New York Knicks, but he's only 6'9". When you look at Mitchell Robinson, 7 feet, 245 to 250 pounds, he's needed. If Victor Wembanyama is who he has to go up against because the Spurs managed to knock off OKC, that's going to be a factor. If it's OKC, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Chet Holmgren, and Jalen Williams, that's going to matter. You need that big body, and not only that, it prevents Carl Anthony Towns from having to play in that middle for significant chunks of time, which is something I support, because I like him out on the perimeter himself, being a facilitator and a sniper.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay Williams expects a seven-game series between Spurs and Thunder
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say it's a seven-game series with the Spurs and OKC.

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Williams
text_blocks.text: I just got to state for the record, I am not laughing at Mitchell Robinson's injury. I'm laughing at Stephen A.'s response to Mitchell Robinson's injury. People at home, calm down. I'm going to say it's a seven-game series with the Spurs and OKC. Because at the end of the day, even though Mitchell Robinson is having surgery, four games in 23 days, ain't nobody trying to hear about a pinky injury. It's time to go hoop. You see how tired Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is? You see the fact that he doesn't have additional ball handlers to make his game? You see the shots he's trying to take? Victor Wembanyama, he's an alien. You see how tired he is? You see the energy he has to exert? Ain't no more excuses. It's time to go win the chip. It's time to strap up.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: I've never been more proud of you than I am right now. That speech that you just gave, that means everything to me. Because damn it, that's what we need to be saying. We ain't trying to hear about no damn pinky.
